why: The article names only three places along the route with an event: Baghdad (departure, 21 June 921), Gurgan (where the party left the Bukhara route) and the Volga Bulgar capital (arrival, 12 May 922). The rest are peoples, rivers and regions (Oghuz, Pechenegs, Ural River, Bashkirs), not stops with a date or happening.
